facts.fact: The African Union Commission says the Internet Exchange Point in Seychelles (dateline Victoria) was launched on 20 February 2015, officiated by the Vice President and ICT Minister, with the AU listing Seychelles among eight Member States that have set up IXPs with its AXIS support; no member count or traffic figure is given.

systems.owner: Department of ICT, Seychelles (set up with African Union Commission AXIS support)

note: Regional Starlink article; names exchanges only for South Africa, Kenya and Nigeria gateways; Seychelles appears only in a Starlink scheduled-launch list, nothing on an exchange point there.

systems.owner: Seychelles Internet Exchange Point Association, Victoria, Mahe

note: PeeringDB organisation record only (address, last updated 2020-02-19, empty networks list); it does not state that an exchange is in service, members or traffic.
Document is an internet-users series; says nothing on exchange points.
